claim: Logic bug in j2534_worker: sched_mode calculation ignores poll_pid, breaking the intended behavior where scheduler outranks poll only when a mux set is active; file: core/src/j2534_transport.cpp; quote: const bool sched_mode = (t->sched.count > 0);
questions: Are parse_query and j2534_attach properly declared with extern "C" for C ABI integrity?
Does resolve_channels always create at least one channel when rx_id is set, even if the filter resolves to an invalid channel?
What is the intended behavior when poll_pid is set AND the set has scheduled PIDs? The new code puts us in scheduler mode, but the original put us in poll mode.
nits: The attach function's channel validation was simplified from checking both sched_mode and poll_pid to only sched_mode — this relies on parse_query's new check but could be more defensive
Consider adding a DCHECK or assertion in the poll branch to verify chan_count > 0 in debug builds
